# IC-7100 — the ALLOWED CITATIONS of core/driver/ic7100 and core/civ/ic7100.
#
# This list is the POSITIVE half of the provenance pins. The tier's only
# blacklist is core/driver/ic7760/provenance_test.go — it names literals a
# rejected IC-7760 branch actually copied from the IC-7610. THIS package has
# no blacklist of its own, and would not be much helped by one: a paraphrase
# walks past a named literal.
#
# This list asks the other question, and it is the one the tier review asked
# for: of every document citation these two packages make, can this model's
# OWN authority supply it? A citation not written here fails the test, and the
# answer is to check the authority — never to widen the list to fit the prose.
#
# The authority. core/driver/ic7100/doc.go states this package's scope but
# never names the document, so the naming below is copied verbatim from §0 of
# docs/superpowers/icom-matrices/ic7100-capability-matrix.md, which is the
# reading doc.go does cite:
#
#   "IC-7100 FULL MANUAL, revision 5, printed document code A7085-2EX-5,
#    May 2021, (c) 2013-2021 Icom Inc." — 387 PDF pages.
#   "The IC-7100 has no standalone CI-V Reference Guide. Its command set is
#    Section 20, "CONTROL COMMAND", of this Full Manual, at PDF pages 360-376
#    = printed folios 20-1 ... 20-17."
#
# The reading is that matrix, its report and its review, together with
# docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-28-icom-ic7100.md.
#
# THE SPLIT. A page, folio, section or erratum must come from the capability
# matrix trio. ONLY a register id may come from the implementation plan, which
# is where several were minted; the plans carry page and folio citations of
# their own, so this is enforced in code, not by convention. See
# CitationPin.Matrix in citations.go.
#
# FORMAT. One canonical citation token per line; "#" starts a comment, and a
# token may carry a trailing note. The tokens are produced by
# core/driver/internal/drivertest.ScanCitations, whose grammar — including the
# bare "p.NNN", spelled-out "page NNN" and bare "§N.N" forms, their case
# variants, and the two shapes it still omits — is documented in citations.go.
#
# WHERE THE AUTHORITY IS ABSENT. docs/superpowers/ is gitignored, so a fresh
# clone and CI do not have it (the v1.2.1 CI run, 30/08/2026). This list is
# checked in and is ALWAYS enforced; the supply check against the authority
# runs only where the authority is present, and logs a skip where it is not.

PDF p.91
PDF p.174
PDF p.317
PDF p.375

# Page spans.
PDF pp.361-375

# Printed folios.
folio 4-26
folio 20-16

# Matrix sections.
matrix §1
matrix §1b

IC-7300 matrix erratum 12  # foreign-attributed: the prose names the IC-7300 as the source of this doctrine (core/driver/ic7300/caps.go:242-251), so the IC-7100 authority is not asked for it
